arguments.statement: 截至 2026-11-04 13:30 的构建记录，镜像 edge-2026.11.4 已构建，状态是 READY_FOR_UPLOAD；registry 上传只是已排队，计划 14:00 开始。同一条记录写明没有 registry tag、digest 或 upload-complete。排队和计划开始不是已经上传，也没有写这是 Atlas staging 或生产变更。

decision_rationale: The build record explicitly separates a completed build and a queued upload plan from tag, digest, and upload-complete. Keep that boundary. Do not attach the image to Atlas or treat the plan as an observed start.
